verdict.rationale: Gusto Embedded Payroll is a documented partner offering. Partners embed payroll into their own platforms through APIs, pre-built UI flows, a customizable React SDK and official client libraries, and system access tokens let them create partner-managed companies. White-labeling is strongly implied by "custom experiences" and the "deeply customizable" SDK, but no doc states it explicitly. Missing for 10: explicit white-label/branding documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of an embedded integration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed white-label payroll into my own product through a partner API

citations.quote: we've created Gusto Embedded Payroll— to help companies like you build and embed modern payroll and HR tools into your platforms in a fraction of the time it would take to build from scratch
Partners can launch quickly with pre-built UI Flows, build custom experiences using APIs, or combine multiple approaches to create the ideal solution.
System access tokens allow you to carry out application-level actions such as: Creating a partner-managed company
A React component library for building payroll—deeply customizable and quick-to-deploy
With Embedded Payroll, you can provide a unique payroll experience tailored to the specific needs of your customers.
